messages.subject: Sleep log time differences
parts:
Hello, 

Reaching out to see if anyone else has had this issue happen. When I run GGIR and review the datasets, I've noticed that the timestamps from the sleep log for bed and waketimes are changed. For example, instead of wake time being read as 03:00:00 (3am), it's being read as 15:00:00 (3pm). I have ensured that the sleep log is formatted correctly and tried several ways of re-formatting to ensure the hh:mm:ss is followed and this still is occurring. I've noticed it's not with the entire dataset but it's impacting the total day duration time. Any input/suggestions are much appreciated! 

Best,
Kristina

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Sleep log time differences
parts:
Hello Kristina,

Did the recordings take place in the same timezone as where you are?
If not, are you specifying argument desiredtz correctly?
Can you check the csv file that it says 3:00 AM and not 3:00 PM?

Best,
Vincent
